title: Kth Largest Value
summary: Return the kth largest value, counting duplicate positions separately.
statement: Return the kth largest value, counting duplicate positions separately. Implement `kth_largest_value` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
reference_solution:
def kth_largest_value(nums, k):
    return sorted(nums, reverse=True)[k - 1]
brute_force_solution:
def kth_largest_value(nums, k):
    return sorted(nums, reverse=True)[k - 1]
